name: 光启技术
amount_policy: ratio_only; no holding market value; no cost amount; no profit amount; no share count
boundary: Stock research dossier input; no portfolio-level buy/sell list and no rebalance action.

summary.bucket_role: 观察股 / 主题试错股
summary.target_position_range: No target position in this dossier; current 1.78% ratio is an input for downstream portfolio modules.
summary.one_line_conclusion: 光启技术主营超材料，2025和2026Q1收入保持较快增长、毛利率高、负债率低，但军工/航天主题未确认为当前A/B交易主线，PE(TTM)约116倍、PB约8.45倍、PS(TTM)约37.61倍，股价低于20/60/120/240日线且资金净流出；Watch only.

basic_info.related_theme: 超材料 / 军工航空 / 航天 / 低空交叉主题
basic_info.theme_rating: 军工未单独登记；商业航天 C；高端装备 B/C 交叉
basic_info.total_market_cap: about 825.85 billion CNY from Tushare daily_basic total_mv; public market cap, not holding amount
basic_info.cost_policy: Cost amount is not recorded in this dossier.

position_role.bucket_role: 观察股 / 主题试错股
position_role.allocation_purpose: Research input for defense/aerospace/new-material exposure; not a core or confirmed offensive holding.
position_role.overlap_with_existing_holdings: Overlaps with 512710, 159378, 159206, 600764, 688439 and 300627 in the military/aerospace/low-altitude/satellite group, which is already about 10.00% in the portfolio.

long_term_logic: 主营超材料产品和超材料研发业务，2025年超材料行业收入约20.35亿元，占收入绝对主体。
超材料产品2025年收入约17.96亿元、毛利约9.38亿元，业务具备较高毛利率。
低负债和较高现金储备提供一定财务缓冲。
swing_logic: No confirmed positive trend as of 2026-06-02.
Price is below MA20/60/120/240 and underperforms CSI 300 over 20 and 60 trading days.
core_assumptions: Defense aerospace and special-material demand continues.
Company can convert high gross margin into sustained earnings and cash flow.
Theme registration eventually confirms defense/aerospace as at least a B tactical line.
likely_failure_points: High valuation leaves little room for earnings disappointment.
Revenue depends on specialized defense/new-material demand and may face customer/order concentration risk.
2026Q1 operating cash flow deteriorated sharply year over year while capex and working-capital demand remain material.

business_logic.evidence: Super-material business is real and high-margin; 2025 super-material industry revenue about 20.35bn CNY.

industry_theme_fit.evidence: Defense/aerospace/new-material exposure is relevant, but current theme registry has commercial aerospace at C and no separate A/B defense tactical mainline.

financial_quality.evidence: 2025 gross margin about 48.97%, net margin about 33.58%, debt-to-assets about 19.00%; but ROE only about 7.40% and receivables/inventory/capex need monitoring.

earnings_trend.evidence: 2025 revenue +31.32%, parent net profit +5.37%; 2026Q1 revenue +40.28%, parent net profit +17.03%.

valuation_odds.evidence: PE(TTM) about 115.90, PB about 8.45, PS(TTM) about 37.61; historical percentile since 2024 is mid-low but absolute valuation is expensive.

trend_and_flow.evidence: Below MA20/60/120/240; 20-day moneyflow proxy about -169703.24 and 60-day about -373104.16 raw Tushare units.

risk_control.evidence: Debt is low, but valuation, customer/order concentration, capex/working-capital pressure and theme concentration are material.

stock_risk_penalty.evidence: Penalty for high absolute valuation, weak trend, net money outflow, C-rated related theme and portfolio concentration.

valuation.conclusion: Absolute valuation is expensive; mid-low short history percentile does not provide enough safety margin.

hold_conditions: Use as research input only if position remains small and downstream portfolio module accepts military/aerospace concentration risk.
Watch for revenue/profit growth continuing with cash-flow repair and ETF/theme strength repair.
sell_invalid_conditions: Earnings growth slows while valuation remains high.
Price stays below MA20/60 with continued moneyflow outflow.
Defense/aerospace theme remains C/D and portfolio concentration remains high.

trigger_table.trigger: Stock regains MA20/60 and 20-day moneyflow turns positive while defense/aerospace theme upgrades
trigger_table.action: Action-plan module may reassess from Watch to small trial holding
trigger_table.invalid: Theme remains C/D or price fails at MA60

trigger_table.trigger: 2026 interim report confirms revenue/profit growth and operating cashflow repair
trigger_table.invalid: OCF remains weak or receivables/inventory expand faster than revenue

trigger_table.trigger: PE/PB/PS remain high while trend breaks lower
trigger_table.action: Action-plan module should review risk treatment
trigger_table.invalid: Valuation compresses or earnings growth accelerates enough to justify premium

data_gaps: No official customer concentration or order backlog data was parsed in this run.
No analyst consensus forecast was introduced.
No peer valuation table was built.
Moneyflow uses Tushare raw proxy and is not equivalent to verified institutional flow.

next_review.next_review_date: 2026 interim report, major order announcement, defense/aerospace theme registry update, or MA20/60 repair/breakdown.
success_criteria: Downstream modules no longer treat 002625 as unprofiled.
Action-plan module uses this dossier without interpreting it as direct buy/add/sell instruction.
